text:
riley: FYI graphs show a short spike in reconnects + quota burn at 03:41 UTC after last night's sticky-route tweak. looks like duplicate charges. anyone seen this?
omar: I see it. per-shard panel shows shard-7 spike. traces for a session show one client reconnect but two reconnect metrics.
obs-bot: alert: streaming.reconnect_rate > 1500 (1m) at 2026-05-12T03:42:00Z
sre-lead: Likely handoff race: router hands session to new host while old host still reports metric. dashboards use sum across collectors so we double-count.
ux-console: Customers saw transient 429s during the spike. should we rollback console change?
omar: short-term: change panel to `max by (env,shard)` and bump alert threshold. long-term: emitter should attach stable `session_owner` or idempotency tag preserved across retries so TSDB doesn't aggregate twice.
riley: Agreed. I'll patch dashboard note and mute alert 15m. omar: I'll open PR to add `session_owner` tag and reuse it on retry. sre-lead: Also file infra ticket to ensure router preserves owner on handoff and avoid dual emits.
obs-bot: action: alert muted by riley for 15m.
ux-console: pausing the sticky-route rollout until canary shows clean reconnect metrics.
riley: thanks, saved noisy pages. :thumbsup:
